title: Apologizing first feels weak… a study shows what everyone else actually sees 🤍
caption:
Apologizing first feels weak… a study shows what everyone else actually sees 🤍 Researchers at the University of Mannheim found that we judge our own vulnerable step as weaker than the very same step taken by someone else.

Who's waiting for you to go first? Tell us in the comments 👇

Going first isn't admitting you were wrong. It says: you matter more to me than this quarrel.

Follow for more true stories about the courage to take the first step.

firstComment: Hand on heart: when did you last go first? 👀

slides.text: Apologizing first feels weak. Others see courage.
In your head, you see everything that could go wrong.
Mannheim researchers studied it: confessing love, apologizing first after a big fight.
People saw more weakness in their own step than in someone else's.
We see our own step in every detail. Others see the whole.
Going first isn't admitting you were wrong. It says: you matter more.
Who's waiting for you to go first?
